title: Relief Extension Months Earned by a Seasoned Plan's Payment Record
content:
**Revenue Cycle Policy Manual — Patient Payment Plans: relief extension months earned by payment record**

**Clause.** A plan accepted at least 6 whole months before today with 9 or more scheduled installments paid less than 12 whole months before today adds 2 relief extension months; a plan accepted at least 6 whole months before today with 6 to 8 scheduled installments paid in that span adds 1 relief extension month; any other plan adds none.

**Effect of the months.** Relief extension months are added to the installments still to fall due over which a relief installment spreads the plan's carried balance; months from every source are added together, and the installments with all the relief extension months never carry the plan past its 24th installment.

**Records read.**
- *Seasoning*: whole months from the plan's acceptance date to today.
- *Scheduled installments paid in the span*: payments on the plan ledger posted as scheduled installments and dated less than 12 whole months before today. Down payments, arrears payments, extra-principal payments and payoffs do not count.

## Table of months

| Accepted at least 6 whole months before today | Scheduled installments paid in the last 12 whole months | Relief extension months |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 9 or more | 2 |
| Yes | 6, 7 or 8 | 1 |
| Yes | 5 or fewer | 0 |
| No | any number | 0 |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical plans)

- Accepted 10 whole months ago, 9 scheduled installments paid in the span: 2 months.
- Accepted 10 whole months ago, 8 paid: 1 month.
- Accepted exactly 6 whole months ago, 6 paid: 1 month — both thresholds are met at their edge.
- Accepted 5 whole months ago, 6 paid: none — the plan is not yet seasoned.
- Accepted 14 whole months ago, 5 paid in the span: none.
